presets.name: C Major Sketchbook
presets.description: Keep melodic sketches in C major while preserving your rhythm.
presets.useCase: Improvise over a C major backing track or explore melodies on an unfamiliar controller.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.

presets.name: A Minor Nocturne
presets.description: Turn free playing into a melody in A natural minor.
presets.useCase: Write a reflective lead or find a topline over an A minor progression.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes into A natural minor.

presets.name: D Dorian Session
presets.description: Explore the minor colour and raised sixth of D Dorian.
presets.useCase: Jam over a D minor vamp with a brighter modal palette.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — fits pitches to D Dorian, including its characteristic B natural.

presets.name: Minimal Motion
presets.description: Short, scale-constrained notes for uncluttered melodic sketches.

steps.summary: Harmoniser — moves notes to the nearest pitch in C major.
Note Shortener — gives each note a 1/8 gate, synced to tempo.

presets.name: Double Tap
presets.description: Two short strikes for every note you play.
presets.useCase: Add a double hit to a pluck or percussion patch; 125 ms spacing suits sixteenths at 120 BPM.

steps.summary: Note Repeater — plays 2 strikes per note, 125 ms apart, each lasting 50 ms. Spacing stays fixed when tempo changes.

presets.name: Chord Repeater
presets.description: Turn a root note into four evenly spaced C major chord strikes.

Chordifier — builds 3-note major-key chords from each note.
Note Repeater — plays 4 strikes per note, 250 ms apart, each lasting 100 ms. Spacing stays fixed when tempo changes.

presets.name: Ratchet Fill
presets.description: Eight rapid, short strikes from one input note.
presets.useCase: Trigger a brief roll for transitions or fills; 62.5 ms spacing suits thirty-seconds at 120 BPM.

steps.summary: Note Repeater — plays 8 strikes per note, 62.5 ms apart, each lasting 50 ms. Spacing stays fixed when tempo changes.

presets.name: Late Answer
presets.description: Move your phrase a quarter note behind your playing.

presets.name: Bass Register
